item.title: Maryland softball falls short in pitching-duel loss to East Carolina, 2-1

item.title: Another storm, another infrastructure breakdown at UMD

item.title: Emerald Fennel’s ‘Wuthering Heights’ is more of a parody than an adaptation
item.description: With overly eroticized scenes and a failing screenplay, the movie relies on its cast and mockery of emotional chemistry to keep the viewer enticed.
